input: Design and print custom bookplates for my library

gold.taskTitle: Design and Print Custom Bookplates for My Library
gold.taskDescription: Create personalized bookplates to label the user's book collection, covering design, printing, and application.

questions.title: What text should appear on each bookplate?
questions.description: Determine the exact wording, such as a name, phrase like 'Ex Libris', or custom inscription the user wants printed.

questions.title: What visual style are you going for?
questions.description: Understand the aesthetic direction, such as classic, minimalist, ornate, illustrated, or typographic.

questions.title: Should any image or symbol be included in the design?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a specific illustration, monogram, crest, or decorative element incorporated.

questions.title: What size should each bookplate be?
questions.description: Clarify the intended dimensions so the bookplate fits appropriately inside the books.

questions.title: How many bookplates do you need printed in total?
questions.description: Establish the quantity needed to plan for home printing or a professional print order.

questions.title: Will you print at home or use a print service?
questions.description: Determine the printing method, as this affects file format, paper stock, and design specifications.

questions.title: Do you want the bookplates to be adhesive or loose?
questions.description: Clarify whether the bookplates should be printed on sticker stock for pasting in, or on card stock to be glued manually.
